judgments.reason: The support_span describes the right-flank soft tissue mass and liver nodules but does not mention lung involvement. The completed label includes metastasis to both flank AND lung, so a span supporting only the flank component partially supports the modifier but does not clinically support the full combined modifier as stated. Additionally, the span references liver nodules (intrahepatic) rather than confirming the flank mass as a metastasis; the flank mass support is present but the lung component of the modifier is absent from this span.

The support_span 'Contrast-enhanced CT of the chest revealed multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules' literally appears in the vignette and clinically supports lung metastasis as part of the extrahepatic metastasis modifier, consistent with the completed diagnosis label.
